rotor_running_tip_clearance.quote: The rotating radial tip clearances for both rotors were calculated to be 0.04 centimeter.

rotor1_aspect_ratio.quote: To eliminate the need for part span dampers, the blade aspect ratio was decreased from 2.94 to 1.56.

rotor1_aspect_ratio_original_TP1314.quote: the blade aspect ratio was decreased from 2.94 to 1.56.

rotor1_inlet_hub_tip_ratio.quote: Because of the flow-path contour (see fig. 1), the rotor-inlet hub-tip ratio decreased from 0.400 to 0.375, and the exit hub-tip ratio increased from 0.461 to 0.478.

rotor1_exit_hub_tip_ratio.quote: the exit hub-tip ratio increased from 0.461 to 0.478.

rotor1_stacking_line.value: axial position of stacking line unchanged from TP-1314 design; LE moved forward, TE moved aft
rotor1_stacking_line.quote: The axial position of the blade stacking line was unchanged from the original design but, because of increased blade chord, the leading and trailing edges of the rotor moved fore and aft, respectively.

profile_type_rotor1.quote: Although multiple-circular-arc blade sections were used throughout, the blading is markedly different from that in the earlier fan because of several interrelated design changes.

unchanged_rows.value: first-stage stator, second-stage rotor, second-stage stator and the flow path are unchanged from TP-1314 (ref. 2)
unchanged_rows.quote: Only the low-aspect-ratio first-stage rotor is discussed herein. The other blade rows were unchanged (see ref. 2). The flow path of this fan, also unchanged, is shown in figure 1

rotor1_thickness_distribution.value: t/c described by third-order polynomial from tip to hub; max thickness moved rearward; LE and TE radii reduced
rotor1_thickness_distribution.quote: To increase the blade natural frequency and to eliminate a potential resonant condition, the distribution of blade thickness to chord was described by a third-order polynomial from tip to hub (fig. 3). Both leading- and trailing-edge radii have been significantly reduced (fig. 3).

rotor1_choke_margin_design.value: about 6 percent intended; actual 3.6 to 6.5 percent
rotor1_choke_margin_design.quote: The intent of present design was to achieve about 6 percent choke margin, a value which does not account for blade surface boundary layers. Actual values ranged from 3.6 to 6.5 percent (fig. 3).

rotor1_deviation_rule.value: Carter's rule with modifiers (low-AR modifiers largely from ref. 3, NASA TM X-3076)
rotor1_deviation_rule.quote: Deviation angles (fig. 3) for the both higher-aspect-ratio blading (ref. 2) and this low-aspect-ratio blading were computed using Carter's Rule along with modifiers. ... Those for the low-aspect-ratio blading were largely based on reference 3.

rotor1_incidence_rule.value: tip to 58% span: suction-surface angle at midpoint between LE and first captured Mach wave set to free-stream relative angle minus ~1.6 deg; 59% span to hub: suction-surface incidence 0 deg at blade inlet
rotor1_incidence_rule.quote: Incidence angles from tip to 58 percent of span were determined by the method described in reference 4. ... This adjustment was approximately 1.6° from the tip to 58 percent of span. For the remainder of the passage (59 percent to hub), the suction-surface incidence angle was set equal to 0° at the blade inlet.

survey_stations.value: station 1 upstream of first rotor (fan inlet); station 2 between first stator and second rotor; station 3 downstream of second stator; axial positions shown only graphically in Fig. 1
survey_stations.quote: Radial surveys of the flow conditions were made at the fan inlet and behind the two stator-blade rows (see fig. 1).

data_translation.value: survey data translated to blade LE/TE along design streamlines (method of ref. 5, TM X-2379); rotor-exit/stator-inlet totals derived from data behind the adjoining stator
data_translation.quote: All data herein have been translated to the leading and trailing edges of each blade row by the method of reference 5.

axial_reference.value: Z measured from first-stage rotor-blade-hub leading edge
axial_reference.quote: z axial distance referenced from first-stage rotor-blade-hub leading edge, cm

percent_span_definition.value: percent of blade span from tip referenced to first-stage-rotor outlet
percent_span_definition.quote: PERCENT SPAN percent of blade span from tip referenced to first-stage-rotor outlet

angle_convention.value: BETAM = meridional air angle, angle between air velocity and axial direction (relative meridional angle based on cone angle); KIC/KTC/KOC = angle between blade-element mean camber line on conical surface and meridional plane at LE / transition point / TE
angle_convention.quote: β air angle, angle between air velocity and axial direction, deg; KIC angle between blade-element mean camber line on conical surface at leading edge and meridional plane, deg

casing_treatment_groove_width.quote: The groove width was 0.249 centimeter. The ratio of groove width to land width was 2.0, and the ratio of groove depth to land width was 6.0.

best_stator_reset.value: first-stage stator opened 10 deg, second-stage stator closed 5 deg
best_stator_reset.quote: The maximum flow range and stall margin was obtained with the first-stage stator opened 10° and the second-stage stator closed 5° from their respective design settings.

standard_conditions.quote: ratio of rotor-inlet total pressure to standard pressure of 10.13 N/cm2; ratio of rotor-inlet total temperature to standard temperature of 288.2 K
